purpose: Measure the ES bid-ask spread so the Path-D feasibility hurdle for ES stops depending on an assumed 1-tick constant. The assumption is load-bearing: at a 2-tick spread ES's advantage over passive 0DTE options disappears entirely.
why_a_new_manifest: The existing paid_data_approval_manifest.json authorizes ES/VX ohlcv-1m only, caps paid spend at USD 9.00, and lists forbidden as 'any other paid item'. bbo-1s is NOT within that scope. Rather than edit a frozen approval record, this manifest declares a separate, narrower authorization.

approval_required.exact_approval_text: Owner authorizes GLBX.MDP3 ES.FUT bbo-1s for the 20 named sessions at DST-aware 09:30-16:00 America/New_York windows up to USD 3.00 to measure ES spread; no other paid data.
approval_required.supplied_via: V4_PAID_DATA_APPROVAL_TEXT environment variable, set by the owner or by the operator under owner direction
approval_required.note: Claude drafted this manifest but must NOT also supply the approval text. The guard's protection comes from a human providing it at execution time.

authorized_scope.estimate_basis: Read-only metadata.get_cost preflight 2026-08-03 for the corrected DST-aware windows: USD 1.478327. Re-verified read-only before any download.
authorized_scope.session_selection_rationale: Evenly spaced across the owned 2025-08-01..2026-07-31 ES corpus to capture regime variation. 2025-12-25 was replaced with 2025-12-23 because it is a market holiday.

forbidden: any session date not in the authorized list
any expansion of the RTH window
re-running the download to acquire additional sessions without a new manifest
any window that does not resolve to exactly 09:30-16:00 America/New_York
hard_requirements: Run metadata.get_cost for the exact request BEFORE any timeseries download and abort if it exceeds paid_cap_usd
Record the actual cost returned and the bytes received in a receipt alongside the data
Do not open the protected 36-session firewall; holdout_open_count must remain 0
Do not modify FILL_LAW, the causal t-60s clock, the label law, or the OOF firewall
No broker, order, live, paper-submit, promotion, or runtime-flag activity
source: Owner authorization 2026-08-03 for ES spread measurement, reaffirmed 2026-08-04 ('proceed to option A') after Claude recommended against it. The recommendation and the owner's override are both recorded in PATHD_NEXT_CLASS_OWNER_DECISION_2026_08_04.md.
why_superseded: The 2026-08-03 manifest declared a single fixed UTC window 13:30-20:00, which is correct RTH on the 14 EDT sessions but resolves to 08:30-15:00 EST on 2025-11-19, 2025-12-08, 2025-12-23, 2026-01-13, 2026-01-30 and 2026-02-18 -- adding a premarket hour and omitting the closing RTH hour, the period most likely to matter for the elevated-volatility conditional spread. This manifest declares explicit DST-aware per-session windows instead. The 2026-08-03 manifest is left unchanged and unspent.
